A literal line ending inside a code span folds to a space, per CommonMark

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p>see <code>a\nb</code> here</p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
